Mr. V's rules of the game

Like a good baseball team, a good class runs on a few simple rules.

1. Have fun

Science is more fun when you are curious. Ask lots of questions.

2. Play fair

Everyone earns their own V Coins. No sharing passwords.

3. Be a good teammate

Help your friends and cheer for the whole class.

About the website

Viewing as Student
On this page
Getting started

1Check your device

Everyone

There is now just one button. The site tells you which device it sees, and one press checks that it works.

  1. The first time you visit, a window asks Want a quick tour? Press Yes, show me the tour to open this tour in a new tab, or No thanks to skip it.
  2. Next you see Your device. The text at the top says what device you are using, for example Computer / PC / Linux.
  3. Press Check device compatibility. The site sizes itself for your device.
  4. If the device it shows is wrong, press Request to owner: device is wrong. The owner gets your request and can fix it for you.
  5. You can open this window again any time from Device config at the bottom of the page.
Tip: phones show the site smaller than a computer, so you can see more at once.

2Log in

Students and teachers

Log in so the site remembers your coins, your progress and your friends. You stay logged in on that device until you log out.

  1. Press Login at the top of the page.
  2. Choose Student or Teacher.
  3. Students: pick your period, search for your name, then type your 10 digit password.
  4. Teachers: pick your name, then enter the site password and the classroom confirmation code.
  5. Press Log in.
Keep your password private. Never share it with another student.

3Home

Everyone

The Home page says hello and has quick buttons to start practicing or find your period.

  1. Press Start practicing to jump into science questions.
  2. Press Find my period to see your class schedule.
  3. Use the tabs at the top to move around. Use the arrows to slide the tabs left and right.
  4. Press Take the tour to open this tour. Press the mail button to email Mr. V.
Learn and earn

4Practice and Study

Students

Answer science questions by unit. Right answers earn V Coins.

  1. Pick a Unit and a Level: Easy, Mid or Hard.
  2. Choose a mode: Stage Practice, Custom Quiz, Study and Review or Challenge me as I go.
  3. Read the question and tap your answer.
  4. Bonus questions are worth 5 to 10 coins. Keep a streak going for extra rewards.
  5. Work from your teacher is now in its own Assignments tab.

5Currency

Students

Your V Coins and the class EXP bar, all in one place.

  1. Class EXP is shared by the whole class. Your teacher hands it out, up to 500.
  2. My V Coins are yours. Earn them by practicing and by finishing lessons.
  3. Rewards: finish your first lesson each day for 35 V Coins. A full lesson with every answer right earns 50 V Coins.
  4. Game play time costs 100 V Coins a minute: 5 minutes is 500 V Coins and 10 minutes is 1,000.
  5. New coin pictures: a single V Coin flies up when you earn one. The bar at the top shows the big V Coin. At 500 or more V Coins, the super mega V Coin shows up. XP has the same three coins.
  6. Your first login gives you a free welcome gift of 100 coins.
  7. Daily tasks give new goals every day. Finish them for bonus coins.

6Game Room

Students

Spend V Coins on play time and play games with the class.

  1. Check your coins at the top.
  2. Pick a game, for example Block Dash, Swing Man, Memory Lab or Bubble Pop.
  3. Choose a level: Easy, Mid or Hard. Harder levels are faster.
  4. Choose how much play time to buy with your coins. Passes cost 40, 200 or 400 coins.
  5. Press Play. The clock only runs while you are playing.
  6. Press Pause (or P) to stop the clock. Press End game (or Esc) to finish early.

7Calculating

Everyone

Numbers about how you and your class are doing.

  1. See your time on the website, your V Coins, class XP and questions right.
  2. Scroll down for My last 7 days and how every period compares.

8Mr.V Enterprise

Students

Extra perks for your account, like bonus coins and more ways to make your profile yours.

  1. You start on the Free plan.
  2. Compare Free, Starter Enterprise and Enterprise+ to see the perks.
  3. Press a plan to buy it with V Coins, or ask a friend to gift it to you.

9My Plan

Students

See your plan, how many days are left and send a plan to a friend as a gift.

  1. Open My Plan to see your plan and the days left.
  2. Read the perks your plan gives you.
  3. Pick a friend and send a plan as a gift. They get an envelope in their notifications to open.

10Assignments

Students

Work from your teachers: quizzes that grade themselves and work you hand in.

  1. Open the Assignments tab.
  2. Press an assignment to open it.
  3. Quizzes use multiple choice, true or false and short answers. Press Submit to see your score.
  4. For other work, type your answer or add a picture, then press Turn in.
  5. Late work is marked late. Pay attention to the due date.

11AI Helper

Everyone

The AI Helper has the V logo. Ask it to calculate, explain science, quiz you, or open a calculator, ruler, timer or notepad.

  1. Open the AI Helper tab. The helper has the V logo.
  2. Calculate anything: type things like what is 15% of 80, average of 4, 8, 15, solve 2x+3=11, square root of 144 or convert 5 miles to km.
  3. Learn science: ask it to explain a topic like cells, photosynthesis, the water cycle, forces or atoms. Then say quiz me on cells.
  4. Windows: ask for a calculator, ruler, timer or notepad. The window stays in the AI tab. Press Show on all tabs on the window to keep it open everywhere, and drag it where you want.
  5. Your teacher can give your whole class a calculator or other window. It pops up on every tab for 12 hours. You can close it any time.
  6. The helper runs inside this website and does not use the internet. More AI features are coming.
Tip: type help to see everything the AI Helper can do.
Class life

12Dates

Everyone

The school calendar from September 2026 to June 2027.

  1. Use the arrows to change month.
  2. Click a date to read about it.
  3. Check Coming up for tests, exams and events.
  4. Fun Friday requests open on Fridays.

13Periods

Everyone

The school day runs 8:16 AM to 3:02 PM. Periods are about 25 to 30 minutes.

  1. The top bar shows where the school day is right now.
  2. Look at each day to see the start and end time of every period.
  3. On Tuesdays there are 10 blocks because of KORT.

14Join Classroom

Students

Connect your account to your period.

  1. Choose your period.
  2. Type the classroom confirmation code from your teacher.
  3. Press Join classroom.

15Friends and chat

Students

Add friends from your class and chat. Teachers can turn making friends on or off for each period.

  1. Find someone at the bottom of the page and send a request.
  2. Accept requests in Friend requests.
  3. Open My friends to chat. You can send pictures and reactions.

16Join Game

Students

Play live games with the class, like a quiz on the big screen.

  1. Your teacher shows a 6 digit game code.
  2. Open Join Game and type the code.
  3. Your profile joins the game. Look at the big screen and answer fast.
Make it yours

17My Profile

Everyone

Make it yours with a school friendly picture, color and badge.

  1. Enter your birthday to unlock the picture and profile settings.
  2. Upload a picture or choose a profile color and badge emoji.
  3. Write a short status.
  4. Press Save profile.

18Settings

Everyone

Turn things on or off so the site feels right for you. These are saved for your account on this device.

  1. Pop-up notifications, speed and big pop-ups.
  2. Sound effects and volume.
  3. Show the tour when you log in, high contrast and an easy read font.
  4. Dark mode is optional. The site starts light.

19Notifications

Everyone

Everything you have been told, newest first.

  1. Press the bell at the top to jump here. A red number shows what is new.
  2. Press Delete on one, or Clear all.
For teachers

20Teacher Tools

Teachers

One window with everything a teacher needs to run the class.

  1. XP and Coins: give class XP and set coin payouts.
  2. Notify: send a small or big pop-up.
  3. Control online, Online and log outs: see who is on and log students out.
  4. Create a game: start a live game with a code.
  5. Suspend or ban and Lock tabs: keep the class on track.
  6. Students, Friends and chat, Dates, Fun Friday, Music, and Site color. (The user info file is now for the owner only.)
  7. Site color now has a color wheel and animated colors.

21AI Helper (teachers)

Teachers and owner

Ask the AI Helper to make a whole assignment or presentation for you. It fills everything in, then you check it.

  1. Open AI Helper. Type what you want in plain words.
  2. Assignments: make a quiz assignment about density due Friday with 4 questions. You can add for period 3 or at 3:30 pm. The editor opens filled in. Check it and press Publish.
  3. Presentations: make a 10 slide presentation about cells. It builds a title slide, goals, big ideas, vocabulary, a thinking question and a check-your-understanding slide with a hidden answer. Animations are already on. Press Save to name it.
  4. Windows for students: give my students a calculator, or give period 3 a ruler. Press Take it back any time.
  5. The helper knows 22 science topics. For a topic it does not know, it builds an outline with blanks for you to fill in. Always read what it makes before class.

22Presentations

Teachers make, students watch

The presentation editor now works like a real slide program.

  1. Press New presentation. Press Templates to add a ready-made slide, like Due date.
  2. Double-click text to type on the slide, or change it in Properties. The font is in Properties too.
  3. Drag a corner to resize freely to any size, for example 324 by 425. Hold Shift to keep the shape.
  4. Right-click an item or the slide for copy, paste, delete, order and more. Right-click the slide on the left to add, copy or delete slides.
  5. Colors include rainbow, gold, silver, and gradients. Use the Background button on the top bar for the whole presentation or just one slide.
  6. Move the Properties panel by its handle so it does not block your slide.
  7. Press Save, then Present. Students open the Presentations tab to watch.

23Animations

Teachers make, students watch

Make text and pictures move, fade, spin or bounce while you present.

  1. Select an item, then in Properties press Animate this.
  2. For Move from Start to End, drag the green Start square to where it begins and the red End square to where it stops.
  3. Choose the style (move, fly in, fade, zoom, spin, flip, bounce, pulse, shake, wobble), when it starts (when the slide opens, after the one before, or when you click), how it moves, and smoothness.
  4. Press Preview to watch it. Animated items show an Animated tag in the editor.
  5. Draw lets you sketch right on the slide. Every line becomes an item you can move, resize or recolor.
  6. Animations play when you press Present. They are not saved inside Pptx or Odp files.

24Open, save and print

Teachers make, students watch

Bring in files, take your presentation out as many file types, or print it.

  1. Press File then Upload a file to add Pptx, Odp, Pdf and Txt files, or pictures, GIFs and sound.
  2. Download your work as Pptx, Odp, Pdf or Txt. Download a slide, or all slides in a zip, as Png, Jpg or Svg.
  3. If you press Save before naming it, the whole screen asks Name your presentation.
  4. When it saves, a full-screen message says The presentation is saved! and asks if you want to Leave, Present or Keep editing.
  5. Press File then Print. The V loader moves around and says Printing.... Then the print page comes up.

25Assignments (teachers)

Teachers

Post work to the whole class, certain periods or certain students. Use a template, set a due time, and post now, later or save a draft.

  1. Open Assignments and press New assignment.
  2. Press a Quick start (Reading response, Lab report, Exit quiz or Vocabulary check) to fill it in, or start from nothing. You can also copy an earlier assignment.
  3. Add multiple choice, true or false, short or long answer questions, or pull questions from practice.
  4. Who gets it: Everyone, Certain periods or Certain students.
  5. Set a due date and time and choose what happens to late work: allowed (marked late), not allowed, or allowed with a note.
  6. When to post: Post now, Post later (pick a time), or Save as draft. Students only see it, and only get a notification, when it is posted.
  7. Open Turned in to see scores. Quizzes are graded for you. You can grade other work by hand.
For the owner

26Owner panel

Owner only

The owner has one panel to run the whole website. Nobody else can open it.

  1. Log in as Owner with the owner password.
  2. The panel has sections: Teachers, Accounts, Locks, Party, Spam, Site and Data.
  3. The login file download only shows up when you are logged in as owner.

27Owner profile

Owner only

Your own profile: a picture, your name, and a button to log out.

  1. While logged in as owner, press your Owner badge at the top to open your profile.
  2. Upload a picture, or use the owner icon.
  3. Type your name. It always shows as Owner/Your name.
  4. Turn on Show me to students and teachers to appear above the teachers.
  5. Press Log out at the bottom.

28Manage teachers

Owner only

Create or delete teachers and choose which periods they teach.

  1. Press Edit to rename a teacher or change periods.
  2. Mr. V and Mr. R can be renamed but not deleted.
  3. Create a teacher with a name and periods. They log in with the site password and classroom code.

29Accounts and passwords

Owner only

Change a student name, period or password, and set the site password and classroom code.

  1. Pick a student. Press Show password to see it.
  2. Change the name, period or password and press Save changes.
  3. Teachers can see student passwords but cannot change anything.
  4. Set a new site password or classroom code. Leave one empty to keep it.

30Locks

Owner only

Stop spending or logins for a student, a period or everyone.

  1. Lock spending so V Coins cannot be used.
  2. Lock logins to keep students from logging in.
  3. Unlock any time.

31Party

Owner only

Starting a party is now five easy steps.

  1. Step 1, who sees it: everyone, certain students, only you, or teachers only.
  2. Step 2, sound: pick from the list of music and sounds, or none.
  3. Step 3, pictures: tap the default pictures you want, or upload up to 10 of your own.
  4. Step 4, design: pick a look and type the words it says, like CRACKLAKIN FOOLS.
  5. Step 5, start: choose how long and press Start party. Parties stop on their own after at most 20 minutes. People can press Leave or Hide.

32IP address finder

Owner only

See who is on the website, what they did before they left, and ban an IP address when you need to.

  1. Open IP address finder in the Owner panel.
  2. You see who is on the site now, who is logged in, and a list of visits. Press a visit to see what they did step by step.
  3. Press Ban IP. Pick a reason: Not part of 7th grade Blue Team (in 6th or 8th grade), Banned for no reason, or Type my own reason. Then choose for how long.
  4. A banned device sees a ban screen with the reason. It always has Log in as owner, so you can never be locked out.
  5. Unban any time from the Banned IPs list.
  6. For privacy, only a scrambled fingerprint and a hidden version of the IP (like 203.0.x.x) are saved.

33Spam

Owner only

Send a burst of pop-ups to the class. It has safeguards so it cannot get out of hand.

  1. Write the message and choose who gets it.
  2. Press Start. Students can hide it.

34Turn the site off

Owner only

Close the website for everyone while you fix something. You can always log in as owner.

  1. Type a title and a reason, then turn the site off.
  2. Everyone else sees the off screen. Their coins and XP are safe.
  3. Press Log in as owner on the off screen to get back in and turn it on.

35Data, login file and user info

Owner only

Keep the shared data connected, download the private login file, and view the user info (note.txt).

  1. The login file is made on your device. It is not a public link.
  2. It can only be downloaded while you are logged in as owner.
  3. User info (note.txt) is for the owner only. Teachers can not open or download it. Press View note.txt online to open it, or download it.
  4. Put firebase.txt next to the website to share data between devices.
On the go

36On your phone

Everyone

Everything above works on a phone or tablet. The tabs slide sideways at the top.

  1. Swipe the tab bar to see more pages.
  2. Use Device config to pick iPhone, iPad or Android. Phones show the site smaller.

About Mr. Rowland

Hi there! My name is Jon Rowland and I am a special education teacher and baseball coach at Elwood Middle School! I went to Patchogue-Medford High School and Binghamton University where I graduated with a degree in geological science. I then went on to get my masters in special education from Touro College. I spent four years as a Teaching Assistant in Elwood, and this will be my sixth year as a full time teacher!

Personally, I am an avid Mets, Islanders, and Jets fan. My hobbies include running, golfing, skiing, hiking, and watching TV shows.
